Pop-up Shops in Amsterdam this week

16 – 22 Nov · 2 events

Temporary shops, multi-brand pop-up stores and short-lived concept spaces selling a mix of goods. Good for discovering small labels and independent makers before they find a permanent home, or for picking up a gift with a story. We update the list every week as shops open and close. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.

  1. The Creative Lab — Holiday Gift Shop

    Pop-up Shops · Christmas Markets · Fashion & Vintage

    When
    Fri 20 Nov – Sun 20 Dec, Tue–Sun 11:30–18:30 (closed Mon)
    Where
    De Hallen (Beeldend Gesproken), Hannie Dankbaarpassage 25, Amsterdam (Oud-West)
    Price
    Free entry
    Organiser
    The Creative Lab

    The Creative Lab's festive pop-up shop is back in De Hallen, with a rotating line-up of independent makers, vintage sellers and jewellers changing every week until Christmas.

  2. Beaumont Amsterdam — first pop-up store

    Fashion & Vintage · Pop-up Shops

    When
    Sat 21 – Mon 23 Nov, Sat & Mon 10:00–18:00, Sun 11:00–18:00
    Where
    Prinsengracht 234F, Amsterdam (Grachtengordel, Centrum)
    Price
    Free entry
    Organiser
    Beaumont Amsterdam

    Dutch womenswear label Beaumont opens its first-ever Amsterdam pop-up store on the Prinsengracht, open for a few days only, until Monday 23 November.
